title: PageRank & Link Analysis
interviewAnswer: PageRank scores nodes by the stationary distribution of a random walk with teleportation: links from important nodes contribute more than raw in-degree alone.
why: PageRank is a foundational web/graph-mining algorithm and distributed iterative-computation example.
intuition: An endorsement from an important page should count more than one from an isolated page.
deepDive: Teleportation prevents sinks and makes the chain well-behaved under standard conditions; repeated sparse matrix-vector multiplication converges to rank scores.
production: Large graphs require sparse/distributed iteration and resistance to adversarial link manipulation.
workedExample: Citation networks can use PageRank-like centrality to rank influential nodes.
